title: Aoyagi Toya — Don't Let It End Yet〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After RAD BLAST
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whew... I'm stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
You really are an amazing cook, Ken.
Everything you made for our after-party was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But... now I'm starting to feel sleepy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too...
I need to hit the hay soon...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys okay?
Well, all of you did push yourselves to the limit, so it's no surprise.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Taking Soma back to the hospital sooner rather than later was the right call.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, it was...
Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pardon me, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But can I get another refill for my coffee?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You still seem wide awake...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because of your delicious coffee.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I appreciate the compliment.
That being said, you've had a lot already...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Are you drinking all this coffee so you can stay awake?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, I enjoyed the first couple of cups very much since I hadn't had your coffee in quite a while. But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd have to go home if I started nodding off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I want to enjoy this atmosphere for just a little bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, you're right. I decided that I should keep drinking your coffee in order to stay awake...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But you made the locals' wish come true by giving that event everything you had. Don't you think you deserve a little break today...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: There's some space in the back where you can sleep. Why not lie down for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't think I'll be able to wake back up in my current state. I'd feel bad about having you let me stay the night suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's okay every once in a while, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you, Akito and Kohane all end up sleeping over, then I'll make sure to tell your parents and take whatever they throw at me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yes, trying to stay awake like this may end up causing him more trouble.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also... I'm having trouble keeping my eyes open any longer.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ken. And thank you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I'd like to go to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Ah, good decision.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, listen up!
If any of you are at your limit, then you're more than welcome to sleep here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Thank you...
My eyes are glued shut...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yawn...
So sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Let her sleep in your room, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let's go, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry, but you boys will need to sardine can yourselves in here. I'll go grab some blankets.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's time for this room of zombies to lie down.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, this seems only natural.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We gave that event absolutely everything we could muster. And then, we had a big party to celebrate.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I doubt I'm ever going to forget what happened today.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can vividly recall the atmosphere that we created when everyone became connected.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And the time I spent together with my dear friends... The happiness we got to share...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll never forget it for as long as I live.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll get you that refill when you wake up, okay, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Ken's coffee right after waking up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't ask for anything better.)
